description: This file defines the PermissionHandler class in Drupal, responsible for managing permissions based on YAML configuration files, including dynamic permissions via callbacks.

classes.name: PermissionHandler
classes.description: A class that manages permissions in Drupal, loading from YAML files and handling dynamic permission callbacks.

methods.name: getYamlDiscovery
methods.description: Initializes and returns the YAML discovery object for permissions files.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts all permissions available.

methods.name: moduleProvidesPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a module provides any permissions.

methods.name: buildPermissionsYaml
methods.description: Builds permissions array from YAML files and callback functions.

methods.name: sortPermissions
methods.description: Sorts permissions by provider and title.

methods.name: getModuleNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all module names with human-readable labels.
